name: Flail Tail (Combat)
body:
The damage of your tail attack increases.

Prerequisite(s): Slitherspeed, Whiptail (Combat), base attack bonus +6, gnorri.

Benefit(s): Your tail attack damage increases to 1d8.

Normal: Without this feat, your tail attack deals 1d6 damage.
